source: Local host rollout metadata, restricted to this benchmark organizer and its selected direct child agents
privacy: Public derivative: measured pilot/fast run request timestamps are expressed as elapsed milliseconds from the earliest task_started boundary for that run, including negative values if any; their numerical usage records are retained for audit. Organizer and preparation-agent per-request records are omitted, as are organizer turn boundaries and repeated context entries. No messages, reasoning text, tool bodies, file paths, account IDs, quotas or session IDs are copied.
counting: Deduplicate unchanged cumulative token_count snapshots. Cached input is part of input; reasoning output is part of output. Recorded last-request sums are cross-checked against cumulative totals. Host-tool byte counts measure rollout argument/output serialization, not token estimates or MCP wire bytes. Organizer and preparation-agent per-request records remain private.
limitations: Usage is host-reported telemetry, not final billing.
Separate text/image token breakdown and actual injected tool-definition inventory are unavailable.
Organizer snapshot and preparation children are separately labeled and not attributed to either arm; the active organizer snapshot excludes subsequent reporting work.
Active sessions may have incomplete final usage; inspect task_complete boundaries.
